intent_summary: Callers can supply a season length; ordered values without one can use conservative season inference with a lag-one fallback.

criteria.criterion: An explicit season length is honored and reported as explicit.
criteria.notes: Explicit field presence bypasses inference, and the test checks the reported source.

criteria.criterion: A repeating positional series can infer a seasonal lag and report the selection window.
criteria.notes: The repeating seven-position series selects lag 7 and reports confirmation window [0, 27].

criteria.criterion: A positional series without a sufficiently stable candidate falls back to lag one and records why.
criteria.notes: Candidate-strength and early-confirmation failures return lag 1 with a reason; the quadratic example verifies fallback.

criteria.criterion: The reserved calibration and evaluation tail does not determine positional season selection.
criteria.notes: Discovery excludes calibration_size plus one reserved sample. Changing that tail preserves the complete inference diagnostics; arbitrary appended-prefix invariance is explicitly outside the guidance.
